rules.accepted_credit_types: AMA Category 1; AOA Category 1; AAAA Category 1; AAFP Category I; AAPA Category 1
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt from the 40 hours at the first renewal; PAs with prescriptive authority must still complete the 3 hours in practice-specific pharmaceuticals.
rules.carryover: Hours used to cure a deficiency for the previous biennium cannot be used for the next renewal.
rules.audit_note: Random audit of a fixed percentage of renewals. Keep attendance records 5 years (provider, date, evidence of Category 1 credit).

topics.who: PAs authorized to issue prescription drug orders: practice-specific pharmaceuticals in which they have prescriptive privileges; part of the 40 hours

rules.notes: At least 10 of the 40 hours must relate to the specialty of the Board-approved primary supervising physician. Late renewal allowed for 3 months after expiry. 2024 proposal adds 1 h hydrocodone/oxycodone and 1 h death certificates; adoption not confirmed.
rules.rule_quote: (1) Physician assistants licensed to practice pursuant to O.C.G.A. 43-34-103 shall complete Board approved continuing medical education of not less than forty (40) hours biennially.
